description: Fix bugs and add missing scenarios for ots below/above commands to make PR stacking reliable in all real-world user journeys

userStories.title: Fix get_branches to only return actual branches
userStories.description: As a developer, I want get_branches() to only return real git branches, not tags or other refs, so the 'branch already exists' check doesn't produce false positives.
acceptanceCriteria: get_branches() in PyGitHubRepository uses self._git_repo.heads (or .branches) instead of self._git_repo.references
Tags, stash refs, and other non-branch refs are excluded from results
Unit test verifies a tag with the same name as a proposed branch does not trigger 'already exists' error
Existing get_branches tests still pass
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Check remote branch existence in below/above validation
userStories.description: As a user, I want the 'branch already exists' check to also check remote branches, so I don't get a confusing push failure later.
acceptanceCriteria: Add get_remote_branches() method to Repository protocol that returns list of remote branch names
Implement get_remote_branches() in PyGitHubRepository by reading origin/ refs from git repo
below() and above() check both get_branches() and get_remote_branches() before proceeding
Error message says 'Branch foo already exists on remote' when only remote exists
Unit tests cover: local-only exists, remote-only exists, both exist, neither exists
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Fetch remote before creating branch in below
userStories.description: As a user, I want below to fetch the latest remote state before creating the new branch, so it branches from the up-to-date destination rather than a stale local ref.
acceptanceCriteria: below() calls CommandRunner.run(['git', 'fetch', 'origin', destination_branch]) before create_branch
New branch is created from origin/destination (not potentially-stale local ref) by updating create_branch call
Dry-run output mentions the fetch step in the action list
BelowDryRunResult.format_output() includes fetch as a numbered step
Unit tests verify fetch command is called with correct args
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Fix interactive mode to preserve provided CLI args
userStories.description: As a user, I want to pass --branch foo and only be prompted for the missing args, so that I don't have to re-type values I already provided.
acceptanceCriteria: InteractivePrompter.prompt_below_above_inputs() accepts optional pre-filled values for branch, title, worktree
main.py passes any already-provided args to the prompter so they are not re-asked
If --branch is provided but --title and --worktree are missing, only title and worktree are prompted
If --branch and --title are provided but --worktree is missing, only worktree is prompted
Unit tests cover all partial-arg combinations (1 of 3, 2 of 3 provided)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Auto-default worktree path from branch name
userStories.description: As a user, I want the worktree path to default to ../<branch-name> so I don't have to type it every time.
acceptanceCriteria: When --worktree is omitted and --branch is provided, worktree defaults to ../<branch-name> relative to the repo working directory
Interactive mode shows the default path and lets user accept with Enter or override by typing
The --worktree flag still works to explicitly override the default
Unit tests verify the default is computed and applied correctly
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add draft PR support to Repository protocol and PyGitHub implementation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the create_pr interface to support draft PRs so below/above can create drafts.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository.create_pr protocol gains an optional draft: bool = False parameter
PyGitHubRepository.create_pr passes draft=True to self._gh_repo.create_pull() when draft is True
MockRepository in test helpers also accepts the draft parameter
Existing create_pr callers still work without passing draft (default False)
Unit tests verify draft=True is passed through to PyGithub
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add --draft flag to below and above CLI commands
userStories.description: As a user, I want to create new stack entries as draft PRs so they don't trigger CI or review requests prematurely.
acceptanceCriteria: Add --draft / -d flag to both below and above argparse definitions in main.py
Flag is passed through to client.below() and client.above() which pass it to repo.create_pr()
Interactive mode asks 'Create as draft PR?' (default: yes)
Dry-run output shows '(draft)' next to the PR creation step when applicable
BelowDryRunResult and AboveDryRunResult gain a draft field and format_output reflects it
Unit tests verify draft flag flows through the full call chain

userStories.title: Handle git push failures with clear error messages
userStories.description: As a user, I want clear error messages when push fails, not raw subprocess tracebacks.
acceptanceCriteria: git push failures in below() and above() are caught and re-raised as ValueError

userStories.title: Handle pre-commit hook failures on empty commit
userStories.description: As a user, I want a clear error when my pre-commit hooks reject the initialization commit.
acceptanceCriteria: git commit --allow-empty failures in below() and above() are caught with a human-readable error
Error message explains that pre-commit hooks rejected the commit
Error message suggests checking hook output or using --no-verify flag

userStories.title: Add partial failure recovery guidance
userStories.description: As a user, when the command fails midway through, I want to know what was already done and how to recover.
acceptanceCriteria: below() and above() track completed mutation steps in a list as they execute
On any exception after mutations have started, a recovery message is printed before re-raising
Recovery message lists each completed step and the exact command to undo it (e.g. git worktree remove <path>, git branch -D <name>)

Tests pass

userStories.title: Support below/above when no PR exists - create PR first
userStories.description: As a user, I want to run ots below or ots above even when my current branch has no open PR, so I can start building a stack from scratch.
acceptanceCriteria: When no PR exists for the current branch, below/above prompts: 'No PR found for branch X. Create one now?'
If user confirms, prompts for PR title (default: branch name humanized) and destination (default: repo default branch)
Creates the PR for the current branch, then proceeds with the below/above operation normally
In non-interactive mode (all args provided), add --create-pr flag that creates the missing PR automatically using branch name as title and default branch as destination
Without --create-pr in non-interactive mode, errors with a clear message explaining the flag
Dry-run shows the initial PR creation as an additional numbered step before the rest
Unit tests for: interactive create flow, non-interactive with --create-pr, non-interactive without flag (error)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
